title: feat(studio): surface pending drafts on the package detail (ADR-0033)
body:
## Context

After an AI builds an app, its objects/views land as **drafts** bound to the app package, but Studio's active-only browsers hid them — so a just-built package looked empty and there was no obvious path to review/publish. (Companion to framework PR objectstack-ai/framework#1552, which adds the `GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts` backend.)

## Change

- `MetadataClient.listDrafts({ packageId?, type? })` → calls `GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts`, returning pending draft headers (with `packageId`). Tolerant of both the bare-array and `{data:{drafts}}` envelope shapes.
- The package detail sheet (`PackagesPage`) now renders a **Pending changes** section: a count badge + each drafted item linking to the existing per-item review/diff (`?review=1`), so the user can publish each. A just-built app package is no longer shown as empty.

## Verification

- **Browser e2e** (showcase, console rebuilt from this branch): an AI-built `app.customer_support` package detail shows **PENDING CHANGES (5)** listing customer/ticket/agent_note/ticket_list/app; clicking `customer` opens the review/diff (confirming `_packageId: app.customer_support`) with the Publish action.
- **Unit:** `listDrafts` request URL (packageId + type) and envelope tolerance. data-objectstack metadata-client suite green.
